run_deprecated_grpcxx_check: run the sanity check script to verify deprecated grpc++ header shim files are correct
run_grpcxx_file_list_validation: run the script to validate the expected list of deprecated grpc++ header files matches the filesystem
run_grpcxx_content_diff_check: run the script to diff each deprecated grpc++ header against its expected shim template content
run_grpcxx_include_scan: run the script to scan src/ for source files that still include deprecated grpc++ headers
review_deprecated_grpcxx_check: review the sanity check script that validates deprecated grpc++ headers and scans for invalid includes
